verses.text: By David, when he acted like he'd lost his mind in front of Abimelech, who drove him away, and David left. I'll bless the LORD at all times. I'll always have praise for him on my lips.
My soul boasts in the LORD. Let humble people hear it and be glad.
Celebrate the LORD's greatness with me. Let's lift up his name together! 🙌
I went looking for the LORD, and he answered me. He rescued me from all my fears.
People who look to him light up. Their faces will never be covered in shame.
This poor man cried out, and the LORD heard him and saved him from all his troubles.
The LORD's angel camps around those who revere him and rescues them.
Taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is anyone who runs to him for shelter.
Revere the LORD, you who are faithful to him. Those who revere him have what they need.
Even young lions go hungry, but people who seek the LORD won't lack anything good.
Come here, children, and listen. I'll teach you what it means to revere the LORD.
Who wants to live a long life and see good days?
Keep your tongue away from evil and your lips away from lies.
Turn away from evil and do good. Look for peace and go after it.
The LORD watches over people who do what's right. He listens when they cry out.
The LORD stands against those who do evil, to wipe even their memory from the earth.
When people who do what's right cry out, the LORD hears and rescues them from all their troubles.
The LORD stays close to the brokenhearted and saves people whose spirits are crushed. ❤️‍🩹
People who do what's right go through plenty of hardship, and the LORD rescues them from it all.
He guards all their bones. Not one gets broken.
Evil will kill the wicked. People who hate those who do right will be found guilty.
The LORD redeems the lives of his servants. Everyone who runs to him for shelter will be free from condemnation.
